what: Grid of MuJoCo gait replays (mojito.gait_replay.run_gait), one run per cell, no randomisation, no interpolation between cells. Placeholder 50/150/150 mm legs, 300 x 150 mm body, 5 V, unverified servo figures, placeholder friction. Mass is the placeholder masses scaled together (1.72 kg at scale 1).
frame_columns: ox oy oz [mm], roll pitch yaw [0.01 deg], 12 foot positions in the body frame [mm] (FL FR RL RR, x y z), 4 pad loads [0.1 N], commanded-stance bits (FL = bit 0)
